recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It completes the terminology cleanup requested by FHIR-19243 while leaving later IG organization and datatype decisions undisturbed.
issue_request: FHIR-19243 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core ImplementationGuide. It requested renaming ImplementationGuide.definition.package to grouping to avoid confusion with NPM packages, renaming ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.package to ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.groupingId, and updating descriptions.
initial_application: Current source already had ImplementationGuide.definition.grouping and ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.groupingId paths, but the Jira-commented commit 6c82a7d4e4ffc589bd92ae82c9e2db27abafdbb4 only touched IG publisher conversion code in this history and no Git commit mentioning FHIR-19243 was found. The current StructureDefinition still used package-era wording for grouping.name and grouping.description, and source/fhir.ini still mapped the R3 ImplementationGuide.package path to the removed ImplementationGuide.definition.package path.
additional_context: FHIR-13405 introduced the pre-rename package wording that became stale after FHIR-19243. The 2018 MnM/FHIR-I WGM minutes record the package-to-grouping proposal alongside FHIR-18050. Later issues FHIR-25428 and FHIR-28140 changed grouping.description to markdown, and FHIR-25458 kept grouping trial-use while evaluating future artifact-organization approaches; none of those later decisions restore package terminology.
reconciliation: Updated source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml to describe grouping.name and grouping.description as groupings rather than packages, corrected the groupingId comment to reference grouping.id, synchronized the checked-in ImplementationGuide SVG tooltips, and updated source/fhir.ini [r3-renames] so ImplementationGuide.package maps to ImplementationGuide.definition.grouping.
source_changes: source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml: changed grouping.name and grouping.description short/definition text from package terminology to grouping terminology, and corrected the groupingId comment to grouping.id.
source/implementationguide/implementationguide.svg: synchronized checked-in diagram tooltips with the grouping terminology after the authoritative XML fix.
source/fhir.ini: changed the [r3-renames] ImplementationGuide.package target from the removed ImplementationGuide.definition.package path to ImplementationGuide.definition.grouping.

related_jiras.note: Earlier ImplementationGuide description issue supplied the package wording that became stale after the FHIR-19243 rename.
Same 2018 WGM context for multi-version IG changes and the package-to-grouping rename.
Changed grouping.description datatype to markdown; it does not change the package-to-grouping terminology decision.
Later duplicate/subsequent datatype request for grouping.description; it does not restore package terminology.
Kept grouping trial-use while evaluating future organization approaches and is already represented on the combined branch.
